svg.title: Directory lifetime admission at both endpoints
svg.desc: For normal copies, each endpoint jointly budgets leaf capacity A and normal and reserved directory lifetimes N and R before readiness. The source requires at least two normal credits, intersects endpoint limits, and bounds scans by W=min(A,N/2) and pending work by Q=min(P,N-W). Ready returns only Begin credit; lifetime credit waits for DirectoryReleased and all local descriptor owners. One inline reserve scan pipelines completion within R lifetime credits; End and release must both arrive before receiver retirement; excess depth reports an error and skips the subtree, or aborts under fail-early. Preview startup uses local metadata admission without these remote lifetime reservations.

g.text: Normal copies: bound lifetimes at both endpoints
Directory owns a scan permit
At most W concurrent scans
Normal group available
Otherwise wait for a group or reserve
Normal admission: N lifetimes
Open one directory and one cursor
Every descriptor alias retains lifetime credit
Move the scan permit into inline children
At EOF, release scan before joining children
N = min(floor(G / 2), T)
One reserve lane; R live directories
Return scan permit when subtree scan ends
Excess depth: report and skip; fail-early aborts
Scan children inline; pipeline their completion
Return after End; aliases retain lifetime credit
Full R: wait for ended siblings, never ancestors
Known headroom: 4A + 2(N + R) + E + 32 ≤ S
B = max(S − E − 32, 0); A = min(E, F, 4096, floor(B / 12)); G = floor((B − 4A) / 2)
Intersect endpoint N/R, then source W = min(A, floor(N / 2)); Q = min(P, N − W)
Unknown headroom: bounded logical admission only. Known B < 12: fail before readiness.
Ready returns Q-bounded Begin credit; DirectoryReleased returns lifetime capacity.
